narrative: This daily brief highlights significant strides in AI, with new robotics navigation models and substantial investments in AI chip development. However, these advancements are accompanied by growing cybersecurity concerns, as AI tools are exploited for malicious purposes and agent-based systems reveal security vulnerabilities. Meanwhile, the aerospace sector continues to attract major funding for next-generation propulsion, and global resource dynamics show important shifts in critical mineral supply chains.
